text.en:
The provisions of Act Numbered Twenty-three hundred and sixty, as amended by Act Numbered
Twenty-four hundred and seventy-eight, authorizing the sale of the lands known as the San Lazaro Estate, in
the city of Manila, are and shall be construed to include all such lands and buildings, owned in fee simple by
the hospital and foundations of San Lazaro as defined and set forth in section three of Act Numbered
Seventeen hundred and twenty-four, as have heretofore been leased to private persons.

The effect of the provisions of this Act shall be retroactive so as to include contracts of sale
executed in accordance with Act numbered Twenty-three hundred and sixty, as amended by Act Numbered
Twenty-four hundred and seventy-eight, prior to the first day of July, nineteed hundred and fifteen.
Enacted, January 31, 1916.
